DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

Pap Smear Examination: Vaginal.

             

                     

  1] Specimen Adequacy – Satisfactory / Unsatisfactory.

                                         

  2] Cellular morphology

                                      A] Superficial cells   ++

 

                                      B] Intermediate cells   +

 

                                      C] Parabasal cells - A few

 

                                      D] Metaplastic Squamous cells - Nil

 

                                      E] Others - x

 

                                             

  3] Inflammation:    Severe   / Mild     /      Moderate   

 

  4] Organisms:   

                          a] Trichomonas Vaginalis – Not Found

 

                          b] Fungal organisms– Not Found

 

                          c] Others – x

 

  5] Epithelial cells abnormalities: Squamous – Not Found

                                                      

          Interpretation Results: Negative for Intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. Acute vaginitis.

                                              

Note: Cervical cytology is a screening test and has associated false negative and false Positive  

          Results. Regular Sampling and follow up is recommended.

        

 

 

   ENCLOSED      :     One Slide (PAP).

                                  (SDC/SM/00/23)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

CYTOLOGY

             

 

 

TEST REQUESTED             :     Vaginal smear for Pap stain.                            

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS    :    Smears show absence of malignant epithelial cells.

 

 

   Maturation Index        :    Parabasal           Intermediate          Superficial

                                                            

                                                            03 %                     37 %                      60 %

                                                       

 

Inflammatory cells / Infection :    Plenty of neutrophils (Severe type).

                                                         

                                                     [1] Candida albicans – Not found.

                                                    

                                                     [2] Fungal bodies – Not found. 

                                                           

                                                   Atypical squamous/glandular epithelial cells – Not found.

                                       

 

                                       REMARK : Acute cervicitis.

                                                        Negative for Intraepithelial lesion/Malignancy.   

                                                    

                                                        Please correlate clinically.

 

   ENCLOSED                          :    Two Slides.

                                                    (SDC/SM/00/23)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

CYTOLOGY

             

 

 

TEST REQUESTED                                 :     Pap’s Smear.                             

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS    :   

 

                                               1) SMEAR ADEQUACY : Adequate.

 

                                                  2) SQUAMOUS CELLS : Mostly the Intermediate type.

                                                      

                                                  3) ENDOCERVICAL CELLS : Several Clusters Present. 

 

                                                  4) INFLAMMATORY CELLS : Dense Neutrophilic

                                                                                                 Infiltration.

                                                    

                                                  5) PARASITES : Not found.

 

                                               6) EPITHELIAL CELL ABNORMALITY : No dyskaryotic           

                                                                                                              or  malignant cell.

                                                                                                                               

                     

                                                   

IMPRESSION                       :    INFLAMMATORY CERVICAL SMEAR.

 

 

 

ENCLOSED                          :    Two  smears.

                                             (SDC/RB/00/23)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

 

Normal smear

 

 

Vaginal smear for PAP Stain

---------------------------------------------------------

 

Moderately cellular smears show benign squamous cells of variable maturation.

Background shows few inflammatory cells.

No atypia or dysplasia seen.

 

 

IMPRESSION :  Normal smear.

 

 

ENCLOSED :  One Slide (PAP).

                         (SDC/SM/00/24)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

 

Inflammatory smear

 

 

Vaginal smear for PAP Stain

---------------------------------------------------------

 

Moderately cellular smears show benign squamous cells of variable maturation.

Background shows dense acute inflammatory cells.

No atypia or dysplasia seen.

 

 

IMPRESSION :   Inflammatory smear.

 

 

ENCLOSED  :  One Slide (PAP).

                          (SDC/SM/00/24)
